{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Compute overall conversion rates (simple, unadjusted)
email_converted = df[df['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].sum()
email_total = df[df['channel'] == 'email'].shape[0]
email_rate = email_converted / email_total

paid_search_converted = df[df['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].sum()
paid_search_total = df[df['channel'] == 'paid_search'].shape[0]
paid_search_rate = paid_search_converted / paid_search_total

# Compute difference
difference = email_rate - paid_search_rate

# Print the raw counts and rates for grounding
print(f"Email: {email_converted} conversions out of {email_total} total (rate: {email_rate:.4f})")
print(f"Paid search: {paid_search_converted} conversions out of {paid_search_total} total (rate: {paid_search_rate:.4f})")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {difference:.4f}")"}
